summary_md: **aiproduck ([@aiproduck](https://x.com/aiproduck/status/2116336853683187739))** summarizes *Evolving Agent Interfaces* ([paper page](https://huggingface.co/papers/2610.28601)). Agent S4 has a meta-agent build and revise a computer-use agent's tools from trajectories, and with Qwen3.8-27B reaches 21.3% on OSWorld V2, 3.8x the fixed-interface baseline (author-reported).
